c-label Label

DeprecatedSince 0.1.0

Deprecated standalone label. Use c-form-field__label inside c-form-field instead; c-label will be removed in 1.0.

This part was replaced. Use c-form-field__label in new code; c-label keeps working until 1.0.

1

Pick this part

Pick c-label for

  • Never in new code. Existing c-label markup keeps working until 1.0.

Pick another part for

  • Labelling any form control: use c-form-field with c-form-field__label.

2

Build it

  1. Start with <label> and add class="c-label".
<div class="c-form-field">
  <label class="c-form-field__label" for="name">Name</label>
  <input class="c-input" id="name">
</div>
